column4: Split baseline for the installed emulator API after public/kernel identity separation
Keep conditional JIT profiling diagnostics outside the installed public API
Add uml_emulator_sync so an embedding host can flush guest block writes at a lifecycle boundary
Add uml_emulator_quiesce and uml_emulator_resume so an embedding host can leave a guest safely abandonable
Remove UML_EMULATOR_INTERPRETER with the interpreter execution engine; retired numbers are not reused
